label: REJECTED_CANDIDATE_DIAGNOSTICS

messages: Each admitted ship must identify a bottom/lower-region boundary point represented by nltl:hasBottomRegionLowerRegionBoundaryPoint and typed as nltl:hullBoundaryPoint.
The boundary point must carry a shell inclination angle represented as a QUDT QuantityValue.
The shell inclination numeric value must be exactly 7, encoded as xsd:decimal through qudt:numericValue.

verdict.admission_scope_verification: Approved scope and exact hash-bound RDFS population proof reused from frozen offline readiness; shape target boundary checked for this candidate.

attribution_basis: Existing exact source-authored query-body matching only; unknown SHACL wrappers/property constraints are not automatically credited as strictly attributed.
